newsitem.title: USA: Woman shoots student, wounds another at U.S. campus.
newsitem.headline: Woman shoots student, wounds another at U.S. campus.

text.p: A woman opened fire with a high-powered rifle at Pennsylvania State University on Tuesday, killing one student and critically wounding another, officials said.

A local woman identified as Jillian Robbins, 19, was disarmed by a student who wrestled the seven millimetre Mauser rifle from her after she had fired five shots. She was quickly apprehended by university police.
Robbins was not a student but lived in a nearby community, university spokeswoman Kathy Norris said. "She fired five shots," Norris said. "She said she saw two people go down."
Melanie Ann Spalla, a 19-year-old communications student, was killed and another student, Nicholas Mensah, 27, was critically injured in the shooting, officials said.
Police said Brendon Malovrh, an undergraduate student, struggled with Robbins and wrestled the rifle from her hands. Robbins drew a knife, lunged at Malovrh and then stabbed herself in the leg.
Police found Malovrh unhurt and applying a tourniquet to Robbins' leg when they arrived at the scene.
